title.zh: Generative Fonts · 先看生成字形

description.zh: 看默认句子与许可，再核下载文件的版本。 展示程序生成的字体与对应脚本，可浏览不同轮廓效果并预览Beastly。已取得并核对Beastly TTF的固定版本及OFL许可，脚本另用Apache许可；当前未运行脚本或验证Glyphs兼容性，网站应用源码与统一价格未核。
description.en: A collection of procedural display fonts alongside the scripts used to transform their outlines. The actual Beastly TTF was obtained and matched to a fixed repository version under OFL 1.1; scripts use Apache 2.0. Script execution, Glyphs compatibility, website application source, and a uniform price remain unverified.

reconstructionPrompt:
Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by Generative Fonts (https://www.generativefonts.xyz/).
Technology stack: React, Tailwind CSS, TypeScript.
Component specification: 看默认句子与许可，再核下载文件的版本。

Visual details from source observation: 我们先对照 Beastly 的尖刺轮廓与 Broken Fax 的折线镂空，再看单页默认句子的密集字形。建议先看阅读尺度，再核输入字体授权；本次未填字或运行脚本。这个入口适合找有程序痕迹的展示字体，已取得 Beastly TTF并核许可，分发须保留OFL与版权、字体不能单售；脚本另用Apache，价格和本地兼容性未核。
Ensure clean semantic markup, fully accessible ARIA roles and keyboard interactions, responsive layout across desktop and mobile, crisp typography, and fluid state transitions (default, hover, active, focus).
